items.description: The entire old backtest implementation is this one file. There is no page JS/CSS under public/interface and nothing in public/src/bundle.js. It does manual bar-by-bar replay trading: crypto candles come straight from Binance, forex/stock/index candles from the get-candles Edge Function. The user opens long/short positions with TP/SL %, sees stats and a trade log, and each closed trade is inserted into backtest_trades. There is no automated strategy and no export. It never reads backtest_trades, has no i18n, and has no requireAuth() call.

report:
## Old /backtest frontend: inventory and dependency check

**The old implementation is one file, `src/pages/backtest.astro` (686 lines).** It has no page JS or CSS under `public/interface/`, nothing in `bundle.js`, no i18n keys, no `window.*` exports and no storage keys. Outside the page, only one CSS location targets its classes.

Two of the task's assumptions are wrong:
- **There is no "Backtest" link in the shared navbar, and there never was** (`git log -S backtest` on Navbar.astro and navbar.js returns nothing). The only Backtest link is in the page's own hardcoded legacy `<nav>` (line 199). The route can only be reached by typing the URL.
- **There is no `nav.backtest` i18n key.** It is listed in `i18nKeys` with `definedIn: []` only to record that it is missing.

### 1. Page structure
| Lines | Part | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 1-4, 686 | Frontmatter and `<Layout lang="tr" spa={true}>` | keep |
| 5-8 | Head slot: duplicate charset; a 2nd `<title>` that has no effect because BaseHead's comes first; a duplicate unversioned `/styles.css` | delete |
| 9-182 | Astro-scoped `<style>` (`.bt-*`, `#bt-chart`, `.btn-buy/.btn-sell`) | delete |
| 183-188 | Lightweight Charts 4.1.3 standalone (184/186) and supabase-js 2.117.3 (185/187) | delete |
| 189-205 | Legacy duplicate navbar; renders a second 64px bar | delete |
| 206-317 | Markup: header/status, asset/symbol/interval/load toolbar, chart, replay controls, stats, buy/sell/close with TP/SL %, trade log | delete |
| 318-685 | Script: wwPage scope, WW_CONFIG fallback and client, candle fetching, chart, position engine with `backtest_trades` insert, replay loop/render, events, bootstrap | delete |

**What the page does**
- Manual bar-by-bar replay.
- Crypto candles come directly from Binance (`limit=300`). Forex, stocks and indices come from `functions.invoke('get-candles')`.
- Auto-exit checks stop-loss before take-profit.
- Each closed trade is inserted into `backtest_trades`.
- There is no automated strategy and no export, and the page never reads `backtest_trades` back.

**Globals, events and lifecycle**
- Its only write to `window` is the fallback `window.WW_CONFIG` (335), with a hardcoded URL and anon key.
- It reads `wwPage`, `sb`, `supabase`, `WwChart`, `LightweightCharts` and `wwLog`. No localStorage or sessionStorage.
- Listeners: DOMContentLoaded (680), window resize through `BT_PAGE.on` (435), and element click/input listeners (631-674).
- Cleanup: `BT_PAGE.onLeave` runs pause and `chart.remove()` (439-442). Async continuations are not checked against `alive`.
- It never loads `config.js`, `i18n.js` or `bundle.js` and never calls `requireAuth()`. On a direct load it therefore has no i18n and builds its own Supabase client, and the navbar runs without `window.sb`.

### 2. CSS
- **Only outside reference:** `public/styles.css:2832-2833`, the dark-mode black-card list. Edit it: delete those two lines and the trailing comma on 2831.
- **`btn-buy` / `btn-sell`:** only in the page.
- Every other class the page uses is a shared `styles.css` class and stays.

### 3. i18n
- The page uses zero keys; every string is hardcoded Turkish.
- No dead backtest keys exist.
- `settings.delete_confirm_warning` (tr:806, en:860, de:829) mentions backtest data and is used by `settings.js:2318`. Keep it.

### 4. Navigation and shell
- **Registration (keep):** `/backtest` is in `SpaRouter.astro:71` (SPA_PATHS) and `page-transition.js:68-69` (APP_PATHS, which drives hover prefetch/prerender).
- **No backtest mention:** Navbar, navbar.js, Layout, BaseHead, sw.js, _headers, robots.txt, sitemap.xml (entry already removed in a9d6af9), site.webmanifest, astro.config.mjs and wrangler.toml.
- **`index.astro`:** legal disclosure copy only.

### 5. Feature gating
None. FEATURES has no backtest flag in either config file. `hasFeature` and `requirePremium` have no callers. The PRO badge and upgrade gating apply only to premium-dashboard.

### 6. Backend touch-points
- **`get-candles`:** its only consumer is the page (line 385). Its interval map has no `15m`, so a 15m request for non-crypto assets silently returns daily candles.
- **`backtest_trades`** (live, read-only catalog query): 0 rows. It has extra columns the page never writes (`asset_class`, `interval`, `tp_pct`, `sl_pct`).
- **Only other reference to the table:** the `reset_user_data` RPC, behind a `to_regclass` guard.
- **Policy drift:** the live RLS policy names differ from the security-baseline migration. This is a note for the backend plan.

### Notes for v2
- Pass the page title through Layout's `title` prop.
- Load `config.js`, `i18n.js` and `bundle.js` like `trades.astro:19-29`, and call `requireAuth()`.
- Keep Lightweight Charts at 4.1.3, or upgrade it on the dashboard and premium-dashboard at the same time. `SpaRouter.astro:127-140` forces a full page reload when two pages ask for different CDN versions.
- If a navbar entry is wanted, add the link in Navbar.astro and navbar.js, an `isActive` case, and `nav.backtest` keys in all three locales.
- Update `PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md` lines 29, 168, 186, 249 and 290.

### Searches run
Excluding node_modules, dist, .astro, .wrangler, .git and repomix:
- `grep -rni backtest`, plus a separate count on `bundle.js` (0).
- `grep -rnE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_-])bt-'` over css/js/astro/ts/tsx/html/mjs files.
- `grep -rnE 'btn-buy|btn-sell'`.
- `grep -rnE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_$])bt[A-Z]'`.
- The page's function names (only hit: an unrelated `openPositions` in quick-add).
- `get-candles|twelvedata|binance`.
- `lightweight-charts`.
- `supabase-js@` and `href="/styles.css"`.
- `localStorage|sessionStorage|indexedDB|wwCache` and `data-i18n|i18n|t(` inside the page.
- Locale greps for backtest/bt./candle/replay/simulation and `nav.*`.
- `delete_confirm_warning`.
- `hasFeature|requirePremium`.
- `grep -c` on the config/SEO files.
- `git log -S/-G backtest` on the nav files.
- One read-only catalog query on `pg_proc`, views, constraints, triggers, policies, indexes and columns of `backtest_trades`, plus a row count.

### Verdict
**No other page or shared module depends on anything the old backtest page defines.**
- **Functions:** all local to the page's closure; none are exposed.
- **CSS classes and ids:** used nowhere else except the one `styles.css` selector list, which needs a two-line edit.
- **i18n, storage and globals:** no keys of either kind. The only global it writes is the fallback `WW_CONFIG`, which `config.js` and `bundle.js` overwrite.
- **`get-candles`:** used only by this page.
- **`backtest_trades`:** referenced only by the account-reset paths, both of which tolerate the table being absent. The table is empty.

The shared modules the page consumes all stay. Deleting lines 5-685 of `backtest.astro` and editing `styles.css:2831-2833` is safe. Keep lines 1-4 and 686, `SpaRouter.astro:71` and `page-transition.js:68-69`.
